next → small resize → landscape resize → release

all nine boundary samples reach result

constraints: Portrait is Orbit's product orientation; landscape uses a compact responsive layout, not a rotated container.
CDP touch requires Chromium with hasTouch=true. It cannot attest native host or real device input.
Browser entries expose no fullscreen controls or requests.
A lifecycle interruption requires an active drag with a changed angle before blur/hidden, then stale release before fresh input.
Sandbox iframe uses allow-scripts allow-same-origin and fullscreen, matching the existing test fixture; it is not the Shell host.

gaps.reason: No Android/iOS device or native mini-game host execution; browser emulation is not hardware evidence.
Shared Shell iframe sample uses mouse; direct phone and sandbox iframe receipts cannot substitute for Shell phone landscape.
Orbit fixture is same-origin; no Orbit-specific cross-origin lifecycle execution.
Orbit ring gameplay has no keyboard/controller binding; do not generate this input combination.
Orbit is a portrait puzzle, not a landscape-locked game.
CDP is a browser protocol, not native WeChat/Douyin/Bilibili touch evidence.
